import pathlib,json,datetime,os,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/.ontrack-saas')
assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
target=root/'tenant-voice-owner-trial.json'
if target.exists(): raise RuntimeError('trial config already exists; no overwrite')
expiry=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)+datetime.timedelta(hours=24)).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
config={'enabled':True,'account_id':1,'site_id':6,'agent_id':7,'sim_slot':0,'expires_utc':expiry}
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voice-trial-',dir=str(root))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f: json.dump(config,f,sort_keys=True)
 os.chmod(tmp,0o600);os.replace(tmp,target)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
print(json.dumps({'owner_sim1_trial_configured':True,'scope':{x:config[x] for x in ('account_id','site_id','agent_id','sim_slot')},'expires_utc':expiry,'mode':'private 24-hour scoped allowlist, activated only after new server code deploy'}))
